summary: Defines a MIB for controlling a Realtime Traffic Flow Measurement meter, especially for specifying which flows to measure. It also provides an efficient way to retrieve flow data from the meter using SNMP. It is a standards-track document at the proposed standard level.

eli5.summary: A meter is like a counter at a road that tracks cars. This MIB is the remote control for telling it which cars to count.
